# Vendor bundle (Torob Products Extractor)

Place the licensed upstream extractor plugin in this directory before publishing the module ZIP.

## Required

```
vendor/products-extractor-for-woocommerce/wcpe.php
```

## Standalone install

Customers may instead install `products-extractor-for-woocommerce/wcpe.php` under `wp-content/plugins/`.

The module bootstrap prefers an active standalone plugin; otherwise it loads from `vendor/`.
